title: one inspect() walks the roots for history.json once
intention: A whole-tree build_inspector inspect() lists the history.json journals of each root once, however many crossings lookups its sieves and scans make.
why: Measured 2026-11-22 on akiendelllinux: a whole-tree inspect() takes 560.6 s, and test_inspector (one live inspect()) 579 s against its 600 s bound (ticket 9cfcc27ca2d3). cProfile of proof_covers_the_ticket alone: 253 s, of which 164 s is crossings._index -> journals(), an rglob('history.json') over both repos called 2041 times, ~80 ms each. _index caches its parse but keys the cache on a fresh rglob, so the walk is never saved. The tree does not change within one inspect().
traces_to: Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled: one sweep re-derives one directory listing 2041 times.
how: crossings.py gains pinned_journals(), a context manager: while open, journals(roots) returns the listing walked on its first call for that roots key; nested opens are no-ops; on close the pin is dropped. _index keeps its (path, mtime, size) key, so a listed journal whose bytes change is re-parsed. inspect() opens the scope after its cache clears, around the rest of its body. The proof counts Path.rglob calls for 'history.json' over one whole-tree inspect() and prints the wall time.

clauses.claim: one whole-tree inspect() over the house tree calls Path.rglob('history.json') at most once per root, and the proof prints its wall time
with no scope open, a history.json created under a scratch root between two journals() calls is listed by the second
inside an open scope, a listed journal whose bytes change between two crossings_for calls is re-parsed: the second call sees the new entry

decisions.text: D1: crossings.py gains pinned_journals() (contextlib.contextmanager), a module dict _PINNED keyed on tuple(sorted((k, str(v)) for k, v in _roots(roots).items())) that journals() consults while the scope is open; an inner open of an already-open scope is a no-op and leaves the outer's close to clear it.
D2: inspect() wraps everything after its three cache clears in 'with crossings.pinned_journals():'.

D3: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause; clause 1 patches pathlib.Path.rglob with a counting wrapper for one whole-tree inspect() and declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 900; clauses 2 and 3 use a scratch roots dict passed to journals()/crossings_for.
